Thunder,Ⓒs.ⒹmeGagarjanaM, GanaDvaniH, jImUtasta-nitaM, meGagarjitaM; and sim. comp.; vi-, sPUrjaTuH-TUH, sPUrjitaM, stanitaM, rasitaM; garjitaM, garjanaM-nA; ‘t(hunder)-bolt’ vajraH-jraM, kuliSaM, BiduraM, paviH, aSani m. f., SatakowiH, svaruH, SaMbaH, hrAdinI, daMBoliH; ‘t(hunder)-clap’ vajranirGozaH-nirGAtasvanaH nizpezaH; See (s.); ‘t(hunder)-storm’ aSanivarzaH-pAtaH; ‘t(hunder)-struck’ aSanitAqita, vajrAhata, See Astounded.
